uninstrumentedCold.scope: IIFE append to script load/menu registration/settings readiness/shadow style readiness; fresh browser process/profile/document, not measured browser process startup or full page translation completion
uninstrumentedCold.separateUiModes: standard lightweight settings and standalone full Options are different UIs; no paired latency ranking

warmTableReplay.scope: Original captured production inflate, decoded JSON and replayed seven fields; actual exports and domain results validated separately

firstNaturalTableObservation.scope: First natural decode in exact IIFE, hooks before append; atob exact table literal, JSON.parse identifies seven fields, four typed constructors identified by actual parsed-array identity
firstNaturalTableObservation.bytesAndProductionInflateIntervalInclude: byte materialization plus production inflation between atob return and JSON.parse entry

coldFixtureFailures.scope: Cold timing harness readiness correction, not production code changes
coldFixtureFailures.actualDiagnosis: The synthetic fixture disables translation, so document#fluent-read-page-styles is absent even in initial successful exact-artifact functional runs. Decoded global CSS and actual settings shadow style are the appropriate observed readiness markers.
coldFixtureFailures.gatePreserved: Wait for decoded CSS and actual settings shadow style; keep native DS on cold document and forced fallback on functional document.

helperVersionBindings.scope: Closure hashes of current helpers and preserved historical helper versions; these hashes were recorded at closure, not claimed as contemporaneous per-run helper hashes. Each run separately binds its config, fixture, production source and browser script SHA.

notRun: model download, audio playback or inference
browser process startup or OS/V8/disk cold-cache benchmark
reproductionLimit: The complete local harness, original raw logs/artifacts/profiles and receipt basenames are not published. Public samples and hashes permit checking calculations/bindings; this is not a one-command reproducible browser benchmark. Build/test commands and experiment patches are published separately.
claims: Finite synthetic coverage and observed timings only; no universal functional equivalence, full performance comparison, SOTA or Pareto optimality claim.
